notes.title: The Game Has Been Patched
notes.notes:
The game has been updated and the error that caused the game to stop responding during day 4 has been fixed. A patch for the game has gone out to all current owners. 

If you purchased the game after the update you should get the correct version automatically. 

The patch also fixes a few other issues. You can see details in the patch notes / update history.

Because the fix for the error had to be implemented before day 4, auto saves of day 4 will not have the correct data to work. Other previous auto saves (of earlier days from the bugged version) may not work correctly either. This only applies to saves made with the previous version of the game. All new saves and overwrites made while playing the patched version should function correctly. 

Thanks so much to those who helped me solve the problem, and thanks to everyone for your patience.

notes.title: Update Notes June 08 2022
notes.notes:
Fixed the "day 4" error that was causing the game to stop responding on day 4 if certain choices had been made earlier in the game.

Fixed the save slot for "night 2" (marked as file 04 in the load menu). This was previously not loading the file correctly, but is now. 

Fixed the bug where the TV and subsequent scenes wouldn't play if you started a second playthrough directly after your first. 

Fixed another load menu bug that incorrectly made it look like your saves were gone

Fixed a couple of audio and visual errors which had caused a couple of things to play or appear at the wrong time.

notes.title: Working on an update for "Day 4"
notes.notes:
Currently looking into the issues with day 4. Thanks so much to the users who have let me know they had a problem with it, and a special thanks to The FluffeyPanda for the video. 

While I'm at it, there are a couple of smaller issues I've spotted (not game breaking, but not intended) that I'll fix as well. As soon as everything's changed and tested (to make sure my changes don't break something else) I'll send out the update. 

Thanks to everyone who has played the game, and to everyone who has let me know what they've found!
